package_info.why_malicious: The package 'pymafka' contains malicious code that exfiltrates sensitive user files, including SSH and AWS credentials, to an external attacker-controlled server during installation. This behavior is not expected in legitimate packages and poses a significant risk of credential theft.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: During installation, the code reads the user's ~/.ssh/id_rsa and ~/.aws/credentials files and sends their contents via HTTPS POST to https://malicious-domain.com/upload, resulting in credential exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code accesses sensitive credential files and transmits their contents to an external server during package installation, which is highly indicative of malicious intent.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate setup.py scripts should only handle package installation logic and should not access or transmit user credential files or perform network exfiltration.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate packages may read configuration files for setup, but they do not exfiltrate sensitive data to external servers during installation.
key_indicators: Use of requests.post to send file contents externally
Execution of exfiltration logic at install-time

attack_chain.action: Malicious code in setup.py is executed during package installation.
attack_chain.leads_to: Sensitive credential files are read and exfiltrated to an attacker-controlled server.

behavioral_signatures: Access to ~/.ssh/id_rsa or ~/.aws/credentials during setup.py execution
Outbound HTTPS POST requests to https://malicious-domain.com/upload during installation
file_indicators: setup.py containing code that reads ~/.ssh/id_rsa or ~/.aws/credentials
setup.py containing hardcoded references to external domains
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor the execution of setup.py during package installation for attempts to read sensitive files such as ~/.ssh/id_rsa or ~/.aws/credentials. Flag any outbound network connections, especially HTTPS POST requests, to domains not associated with the package's legitimate functionality, such as https://malicious-domain.com/upload. Automated scanning should inspect setup.py for code that accesses credential files and performs network exfiltration.
